notes.title: Major update is a remaster
notes.notes:
If you already had The Cat and the Coup in your Steam library, you might have noticed a significant update.  

Last year we remastered it in 4K.  Everything is re-coded, the sound and music are updated, and the art/world is significantly embellished.  Indeed, we released this remaster last year for $1.99, but now it's time to go back to Plan A - give it away to all as an update of the 2011 release.

notes.title: New Release: The Cat and the Coup
notes.notes:
2011 IGF Finalist The Cat and the Coup is now available for free on Steam.

The Cat and the Coup is a documentary game in which you play the cat of Dr. Mohammed Mossadegh, the first democratically elected Prime Minister of Iran. During the summer of 1953, the CIA engineered a coup to bring about his downfall. As a player, you coax Mossadegh back through significant events of his life by knocking objects off of shelves, scattering his papers, jumping on his lap and scratching him.
